scope: fresh edition publication, shared Brief/Watchlist discovery, reader-book integration, independent live QA, factual repair and owner-only operations
resource_policy: Plus Work/Codex allowance and built-in premium image generation only; no paid API, added credits, overage, top-up, upgrade or alternate account

failed_attempts.evidence: The local bundle executable was unavailable. Candidate and production GitHub CI completed the deterministic Jekyll build successfully before success was reported.
The cadence-aware registry recorded 44 sources not due, two requiring assisted review and three unavailable. Eight verified topics were retained with original evidence dates.

The first live audit found the podcast publisher URL returned 404 and the recorded date/runtime were inaccurate. Canonical-first PR #109 corrected the source to the September 14 publisher page, added the verified 37-minute runtime and Apple Podcasts evidence, regenerated affected views and passed live verification.

Two failed repair CI attempts were retained: a repository-transport truncation in the generated archive index and an invalid correction identifier. Both were fixed before the exact repair head passed.
The owner-only checkpoint upload succeeded, but independent signed-download readback returned transient gateway errors. Upload persistence is confirmed without claiming a full byte round-trip.

usage.reason: The platform did not provide edition-attributed credit or dollar data. Drafts, rejects, repair attempts and elapsed time were measured and saved privately.
